headline: Argentina Loses Top Energy Official Daniel González in Blow to Shale Boom
summary: Daniel González, an ex-Merrill Lynch investment banker and former chief executive of state oil giant YPF SA, has stepped down from his energy post in the Milei government.
why: YPF SA is Argentina's state-controlled petroleum company and a key driver of the Vaca Muerta shale development.

impacts.name: YPF SA
impacts.why: The departure of a key former executive and government energy official introduces uncertainty for state-backed shale development strategies.
